hero.tagline: Aerospace engineer. Coder on the side. Building out of curiosity.
hero.lede: I'm an engineer by training and a systems thinker by nature. I studied Space Engineering with an Aerospace specialization and now work as a Systems Engineer in surveillance. That mindset extends beyond my career into the software I build, the homelab I run, and the ventures I'm creating.
hero.quote: I combine engineering, software, and curiosity to build things that solve real problems.

engineer.title: Engineer
engineer.body: MSc in Space Engineering with an Aerospace specialization. Currently working as a Systems Engineer within Surveillance.

developer.title: Developer
developer.body: Building software, experimenting with DevOps and Kubernetes, running my own homelab in my free time, implementing GitOps principles.

builder.title: Builder
builder.body: Creating products and tools — currently building a venture in Sri Lanka alongside my software work.

exploring.title: Currently Exploring
exploring.body: My homelab runs a full Kubernetes cluster, managed declaratively through GitOps — infrastructure as code applied to my own hardware. It's where I test ideas before they reach production elsewhere.

sriLanka.title: Sri Lanka
sriLanka.body: A new venture spanning Sri Lanka and Sweden, early in its journey. More to come as it takes shape.

about.title: About
about.teaser: Outside of engineering and code, I follow football, play games, cook, and listen to too many podcasts. I'm also learning Sinhala — slowly.
about.paragraph2: I studied Space Engineering because I was fascinated by space, aviation, physics, and engineering. That curiosity has stayed with me ever since — shaping how I build software, run my homelab, and create new ventures.

blog.title: Blog
blog.teaser: Notes from my life — mostly tracking progress learning Sinhala, and the occasional infrastructure write-up.
